question: {}₁₈⁴⁰{Ar} { and } {}₂₀⁴⁰{Ca} are a pair of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Isobars**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Isobars:** Atoms of different chemical elements having the same mass number but different atomic numbers are called isobars.

 For example, **${}₁₈⁴⁰\text{Ar}$** and **${}₂₀⁴⁰\text{Ca}$** both have a mass number of 40 but different atomic numbers (18 and 20 respectively).
 
• **Explanation:** The mass number (sum of protons and neutrons) is the same for ${}₁₈⁴⁰\text{Ar}$ and ${}₂₀⁴⁰\text{Ca}$, but their atomic numbers differ. *Hence, they are classified as isobars.*
